newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand suffers versus dollar into weekend.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand suffers versus dollar into weekend.

text.p: 1415 GMT - South African rand ending weaker as morning gains eroded by importer interest while bonds drift sideways as benchmark yield pokes through big figure at close.
* Rand last quoted at 4.5635/5665 to the dollar from 4.5585/5615 Thursday having traded in three-cent range.

* Dealers say while historic volatilities at 2.5, three-month implied at 7.5, suggesting some short-term nerves. Dealers say physical market action unrelated and unsure how long options players can justify implied volatilities if rand keeps to longer term 4.53-58 range.
* In crosses, rand touch weaker on mark, firmer versus sterling and yen.
* Benchmark R150 long bond last at 13.995 percent from Thursday's close of 14.04 percent. The loan notched up latest 17-month low of 13.965 in early morning dealings.
* Dealers say market waiting for next week's economic data for direction.
* June trade, M3, private sector credit, CPI and reserves data due from Monday next week.
